hits.evidence: Construction has started on the club's own 10,000-seat Arctic Arena at Thalleveiåkeren just outside central Bodø (target 2027), replacing the 8,270 Aspmyra; supporters are part-funding it through the Glimt-steinen campaign.

In July 2026 the club received a final, enforceable permit for its own 40,116-seat stadium on the Olympiasite in Bruges, leaving the athletics-era Jan Breydel shared with Cercle; works start autumn 2026, opening targeted 2029.

Owner Bart Verhaeghe settled the Clean Hands (Propere Handen) case with the federal prosecutor in December 2022 (fine paid; document falsification in the Diatta transfer), so he will not be tried; no similar case since.
Three permanent head coaches since mid-2024: Vítor Bruno (sacked Jan 2025), Martín Anselmi (Jan-July 2025), Francesco Farioli (since July 2025). out3 did not count the churn.

Roma's own ~60,000-seat Pietralata stadium in Rome has city council approval (March 2026) and a positive Conferenza dei Servizi (Sept 2026), with building due to start in 2027. It will replace the shared Olimpico athletics bowl.
Three permanent head coaches in 2024-25: Rúben Amorim (to Nov 2024), João Pereira (Nov-Dec 2024, sacked after eight matches), Rui Borges (since Dec 2024). out3 did not count the churn.
